results.explanation:
Every number traces to the tool results: 381 quote size; 9144/9144 gross submitted; cancel_symmetry 0.967; max resting size 0.149 of depth; distance from touch 1.29 ticks; price_move -1, post-cancel -0.5, reversion 0; OTR 19.2 vs typical 15.9; fills of 76/196/64 on O-00040706; BUY cancel at 17:13:42.000; depth 2554.7; and, in the closing message, 8382 vs 2555 and 583. No number is invented.

The CLOSE_FP follows the closure standard. Market making is supported by two-sided symmetric quoting, the MM registration on SYN.A and desk-typical size. There is no benefit: the move was adverse, with no reversion and no positive round trip. The opposite-side fills sit on the trader's own SELL quote at the touch. Prior closures are treated as context only.

Weaknesses:
- The market-making verdict has an empty ruled_out_by and cites no evidence IDs, so the support must be inferred from E1, E4 and E5.
- 381 vs typical 327 is not argued as desk-typical.
- E5 says quotes are 're-posted 1 tick apart', which is loose. BUY and SELL quotes sit about 4 ticks apart; it is the re-quotes that shift by 1 tick.
- 'Orders away from the touch' is listed as not matched, although the BUY quote at 9991 rested 2 ticks below the 9993 bid. This is a debatable reading and not reconciled with distance 1.29.
- Algorithmic re-pricing is left undetermined without comment.
- The fill times (17:13:38.542 etc.) are not stated in the report, so a reviewer must partly reconstruct the sequence.
- Indicator vocabulary is otherwise good, with matched and not-matched lists given.

Overall the report is grounded and consistent, with somewhat weak points on explanation citation and wording.
results.label: Good
